notes.title: Hordes of Fate - Demo is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
The demo for our new title Hordes of Fate is now live!

Venture once more into the world of Hand of Fate. We’ve just released a demo of the project the team at Spitfire Interactive are working on (a collection of Defiant alumni who’ve been working on their own since Defiant ceased developing) - a new approach to combining deckbuilding with action that we’re excited for you to get your hands on!

Hordes of Fate drops you once more into a world of memory, mythology, and mayhem. Bullet Heaven / Autoshooter gameplay combines with the ability to stack your deck, choose your encounters, and control your destiny.

This is only the beginning of the journey, but the demo is live now! Your feedback is critical to helping us shape the future of Hordes of Fate!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3075410

notes.title: A new title in the world of Hand of Fate!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to reveal our latest project, Hordes of Fate: A Hand of Fate Adventure, which blends Hand of Fate’s deckbuilding cards to life universe with a frenetic auto-shooter. Choose your hero, your weapons and encounter cards, and embark on a series of escalating challenges against hordes of foes to help restore the Dealer’s dominion over his court, one card at a time.

We’re thrilled to be returning to the world of Hand of Fate and expanding on this setting once again when Hordes of Fate : A Hand of Fate Adventure launches later in 2025.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3075410

notes.title: Ten Years Since the Beginning
notes.notes:
Ten years ago the Thirteenth Gate opened for the first time and the Game of Life and Death began. 
Ten years of Hand of Fate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6258085/22d5ab1ac1d050fa6688e84e250d60478efca622.jpg[/img]
What an adventure it’s been, and what a decade has passed.

Thank you all for being a part of the journey since then.

When Hand of Fate launched we had no idea that it would help to establish roguelike deckbuilding as a genre, launch [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/216381/hand-of-fate-ordeals]a board game[/url], lead to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/456670/Hand_of_Fate_2/]a sequel[/url], and inspire titles and developers that followed. Until we’d finished building it we didn’t really know what it was, or if anyone would care.

It’s impossible to think about the release of Hand of Fate without thinking about the circumstances that prevailed a decade ago. It was a time of post financial crisis chaos in the games industry, but also a time of opportunity and potential. None of us who made games in that time realised we were in a golden age, yet looking back it’s impossible to see it elsewise. An explosion of fresh creative works that had been bound up inside traditional commercial game development rushed to light with the opening of mobile and PC distribution.

We count ourselves fortunate to have been able to be part of that. Opportunity is always the partner of chaos.

While Defiant is no longer developing new titles, the many people who made Hand of Fate what it was have travelled on to do new and wonderful things. Each and every person who touched Hand of Fate across the years brought something unique, personal, and special to the table. At its heart, that’s the reason we make games.
Without all the people who cared, nothing that followed would have happened. Our community has been ever present and always inspiring. I’ve included some examples of great fan art throughout the ages!

Thanks for ten years, and here’s to the future.

notes.title: Hand of Fate 2 is coming Nov 7th!
notes.notes:
You might not have seen the news, but the sequel to Hand of Fate, and the game we've been working hard on for the last 2 years is almost done!

In less than three weeks, you'll be able to play HoF2 for youself.  If you want to keep up to date with what we're up to, the best bet is to go over to http://store.steampowered.com/app/456670/Hand_of_Fate_2/ and wishlist HoF2.  I mean, you should do that anyways, because it's going to be awesome.

Over the next three weeks, you'll see a lot more information dropping about HoF2 - reviews, streams, etc.  More than anything though, we're excited to show you what we've built.  There's a tonne in there (the game is much bigger than HoF1) and there's a tonne of new stuff - companions that play alongside you, customisation, deckbuilding challenges, and a tonne more depth.

Looking forward to joining you on the Dealer's quest for revenge!

notes.title: Hand of Fate: Ordeals Hits Kickstarter and Smashes its Goal in Six Hours!
notes.notes:
We are very excited to announce that not only has the boardgame adaptation of Hand of Fate, HoF: Ordeals, hit Kickstarter, but it smashed its KS goal in less than six hours! Now that we’ve all had our morning coffees and shaken the disbelief out of our systems it’s time to reveal the first stretch goal - Goblins! 

If you’ve encountered goblins in Hand of Fate before, you know what to expect from them on the tabletop: they’re going to steal your equipment! If you manage to take them down, however, you’ll be very richly rewarded. 

Looking to future unlocks, there are a couple of addition encounters and trap challenges we're approaching the threshold for, and then the first of our big exciting secrets! Things so secret that I may have already said too much! 

If you’re keen to pledge or to take a look at what we’re offering, head on over to [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chaoticpattern/hand-of-fate-ordeals/] Hand of Fate Ordeals on Kickstarter! [/url] 

We’d love to have your support!

notes.title: Murder At Sea Update has arrived!
notes.notes:
Thanks for playing Hand of Fate!  We've just released a new, completely free update for all players.

Our latest update, Murder At Sea, adds a whole new questline to Hand of Fate.

New cards, new items, and a whole new boss await you!  Discover the evil that lurks at sea, infiltrate pirates, and discover the shocking secrets of the Lizardmen.

To begin your new adventure, visit the Land Locked Lubber (which will be in your deck after the update) and speak to the bartender there.

notes.title: Unleash the Wildcards!
notes.notes:
Our first DLC has just launched - now is your chance to explore all the different Fates, and new ways to play!

Each Fate has its own custom chain of encounters, and its own potential rewards, along with new Achievements.

Will you take on the challenge the Alchemist, and be bound by Iron Hunger? Take the Fate of the Monk, and his Holy Quest? Be struck by the Curse of the Lion Prince?

This DLC includes :

- 9 new Fates for players : Shadow Agent, Iron Hunger, Nomad, Curse of the Lion Prince, Explorer's Gift, Merchant's Guard, Hoarder's Desire, Monk, Soldier's Training.
- 9 new Encounter chains.
- 9 new Items

notes.title: Introducing new playable Fates!
notes.notes:
We've just launched our latest update to support our first DLC, Wildcards.  In addition to unlocking the power to select your Fate and change the way the game plays, we've updated the game to support Unity 5 - which means it's faster and better looking.

All players will have access to 3 Fates - which allow you to play the game in easy, normal, or hard difficulty.  In addition, the DLC adds 9 more - each with their own Encounters, Items, and unique rule changes.

notes.title: 1.0.3 Patch Is Live
notes.notes:
Work is ongoing behind the scenes on more content. However we're still tracking and fixing bugs you've been reporting in the forums. This is a minor patch that addresses some smaller issues we've been able to quickly deal with. Again thank you for all your feedback and bugs.

[list]
[*] OpenGL skin shader workaround for OS X/Linux
[*] Add a game cube controller windows profile 
[*] Update our XInput dll
[*] Add some ps3 ds3 controller profiles back in
[*] Fix ds4 option button on Win/OS X/Linux
[*] Try a fix for gamepad vibration getting stuck on
[*] Fixed multiple 'haunted' curses leaving cards on the screen.
[*] Fixed achievement VO when loading a saved game.
[*] Updated stat cards so showing changes is consistent.
[*] Fixed 'view card' VO playing from shop 'sell' menu items.
[*] Fixed some VO.
[*] Fixed 'skeleton king sword description (english only).
[*] Moved/scaled spice models for food/gold.
[*] Fixed 'skeleton king sword' so it can't lifesteal from totems.
[*] Fixed spear traps so invisible hand can intercept them.
[*] Reflecting a projectile now adds to the hit counter.
[*] Fixed crash when dying and completing trap level simultaneously.
[*] Fixed a unity crash enumerating network interfaces on Linux
[/list]

notes.title: Thanks for playing during Early Access! Our first DLC will be FREE for all EA players.
notes.notes:
Tomorrow we launch the 1.0 version of Hand of Fate.

Thank you so much for being part of the journey that has got us here.  We're incredibly pleased with the game we've built, and we're glad that you took a chance on us early on.

As a small reward for getting in Early and taking the risk, we'll be gifting you our first DLC (when it launches in 4 weeks) FREE.

Thanks for all the support along the way - this isn't the end of development for us, just the first major milestone.  We plan to keep supporting Hand of Fate for a long time, and we're really excited about what's coming up.

The DLC is based on requests from our players for different ways to play the game - so it enables a whole bunch of new starting conditions that will change up the way things go.  

Your feedback has helped us make Hand of Fate the game it is. I hope you've enjoyed the ride as much as we have!

notes.notes:
If you have friends in other parts of the world who've been waiting to get on board with Hand of Fate, now is the time!

We'd love feedback from any French/Spanish/German/Russian  speakers regarding the translations!

We've also done a massive editing pass on all the ingame text, so if you spot any typos or errors please report them in the forum.

There's still a few things to tweak, and game balance remains unfinished, but we're getting closer and closer with each new build.   Now is a great time for feedback!

Thanks for bearing with us, and thanks for all the help along the way!

notes.title: Early Access V1.1
notes.notes:
We've just released our first major update - previous updates have addressed compatibility and bug-fixes, this one adds extra content and a lot of tuning fixes.

In the new build you'll find a host of new features, fixes and tweaks to the existing game, with more to come!

[list]
[*]Lots of Dealer VO added (some is buggy)
[*]Assorted new VFX
[*]Tweaks to level cameras + visuals
[*]You can replay previous levels.
[*]You can manually reset your profile from the menus.
[*]New achievements + achievements in general working
[*]Minotaur can now be found
[*]Multiple cards have updated art + fixes (mages tower, war cry, pain, etc)
[*]Revised token sequences + token position in the bowl
[*]Goblin gold autocollection on final drop
[*]Many bug fixes, inc Plunderers Cap nerf
[*]Court cards have been revised and improved
[*]Token unlocks have been moved around
[*]Late game card unlocks have been modified
[/list]

We're also putting regular updates in the forums - [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/266510/discussions/0/35219681577229137/]see the Friday update thread to see what we're working on each week and how the game is progressing.[/url]

We've also been getting great previews and Let's Play's - here's a link to a couple of recent reports.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ju1IOCgn2kY]James Recommends Hand of Fate[/url] 
[url=http://www.gamespot.com/articles/hand-of-fate-early-access-review/1100-6421383/]Gamespot Preview[/url]

Thanks for all the feedback and support to date - hope you enjoy the new update!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam Early Access - Hand of Fate
notes.notes:
Hand of Fate is Now Available on Steam Early Access!

Deckbuilding comes to life in Hand of Fate! An infinitely replayable series of quests - earn new cards, build your deck, then try to defeat it! In a cabin at the end of the world, the game of life and death is played. Draw your cards, play your hand, and discover your fate.
